q: What does ef_search control in HNSW?
options: The size of the candidate list at query time, trading latency for recall
explain: It is the main query-time knob.

q: How do you measure an ANN index’s recall?
options: Compare its top k with exact brute-force results on sample queries
explain: Exact search on a sample is the ground truth.

q: Why can very selective filters hurt HNSW search?
options: Filtering during traversal can disconnect the graph, returning too few results
explain: Test with your real filter mix.
